domain_hint: Avionics enclosure cold-plate conjugate heat transfer with fan cooling and coolant loop
ambiguity_notes:
- Treatment of near-wall resolution vs chosen turbulence model: slides claim y+ ~1–5 for SST but QA notes median y+ ~35 on the validation mesh.
- Steady vs unsteady physics: justification for steady runs conflicts with test evidence of 8–10 Hz fan-induced unsteadiness.
- Boundary/input fidelity: fan curve at 24 V used in CFD while validation test ran at 18 V; inlet gas modeled as air though test used nitrogen; inlet temperature 20 C vs lab 23–24 C.
- Validation claims: summary says “within 3% on all key points” while detailed table shows up to ~11% deviation and a 12 K outlier (T12).
- Numerics order: deck states second-order schemes, yet first-order upwind was used for 300 iterations without noting potential impact on accuracy.
- Configuration management: some parametric runs executed in a different software version and an untracked “quick-turn” fan curve adjustment outside the repository.
